mapper.select: SELECT master_ingredient_id, category_id, name, default_unit, default_shelf_days, created_at FROM public.ingredient_master WHERE master_ingredient_id = #{masterIngredientId}
SELECT master_ingredient_id, category_id, name, default_unit, default_shelf_days, created_at FROM public.ingredient_master WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1

SELECT master_ingredient_id, category_id, name, default_unit, default_shelf_days, created_at FROM public.ingredient_master WHERE name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY master_ingredient_id ASC
SELECT master_ingredient_id, category_id, name, default_unit, default_shelf_days, created_at FROM public.ingredient_master ORDER BY master_ingredient_id ASC

SELECT im.master_ingredient_id, im.category_id, ic.category_name, im.name, im.default_unit, im.default_shelf_days FROM public.ingredient_master im JOIN public.ingredient_category ic ON im.category_id = ic.category_id
AND im.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND im.category_id = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY ic.category_id ASC, im.name ASC
